tasks.title: Console setup posts each form's own token and completes sign out all
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, all Behavior bullets, Checks to run before handoff and Completion evidence; Required behavior 1-7, Security impact checklist, Counterexamples, Acceptance evidence 1-6 and Rollout order. Make form_token_args take an exact fixed-string action path, clear ftok on every selection and read only the first matching form, including multiple forms on one line, with no fallback to unrelated tokens. Update every call site, omit form_token in both step-7 closed-setup probes, and fetch GET /account/sessions/sign-out-all in jar A after the sessions-list assertion before selecting csrf and the confirmation form's token for step 11. Preserve optional tokens, the intentional same-path legacy replay and every existing ok: line; extend the script header with the exact-form rule. Build the real-script PATH-stub harness with docker, curl and node, all four layouts and cases A-F, path-bound single-use token validation, private request logs, literal output assertions and secret scans on success and failure. In around, put a distinct-token <path>/x prefix decoy before the target and a distinct-token unrelated /sign-out decoy after it, all on one line; keep both factor forms adjacent with their shared token. Prove cases B and C reject a temporary exact-to-prefix selector mutant with status 409 while passing with the exact selector. Add the specified lint-job step and Commands row, update the README form-token paragraph and add the test sentence. Keep console code and CI, csrf(), image/action pins and dependencies unchanged. Include old-script proof, the one-line prefix-mutant diff and failing lines, real-stack results or the documented local limitation, and security evidence in the PR. Acceptance evidence 6 is post-merge rollout evidence: deploy-main dev stays green, and the console PR #9 deploy-dev rerun is recorded on #722; neither requires a console commit or CI change.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; ends with 'console-setup.test: 6 cases passed'. A: two-factor/pr9 and B: two-factor/around finish steps 1-13. C: legacy/around includes 'ok: 8b POST /sign-in replay 409 Already submitted'. In B and C every posted-from page places the distinct-token <path>/x prefix decoy before the exact-action target and the distinct-token unrelated /sign-out decoy after it, all on one line; both /sign-in/factor forms stay adjacent and share the target token. D: legacy/none and E: legacy/mixed include 'ok: 8b replay check skipped: console without form_token'; D logs zero form_token fields and E logs none on POST /sign-in. F captures script exit 1 and 'FAIL: step 11 sign out all: status 500, want 303'. All cases assert no form_token on the step-7 POST /setup, correct action binding for every submitted token, and no fixture secret in either output stream. A-E match literal complete ok: lists; only Checks: N. uses the independent full/config/api/checks.json count. Stubs use fresh per-case state, no Docker or network, and no TOTP sleep.

acceptance.command: old_worktree=$(mktemp -d /tmp/pulse-deploy-726-old.XXXXXX) && git worktree add --detach "$old_worktree" 0157775f8046dbfd18f14d153322adfa6a44ca30 && cp e2e/console-setup.test.sh "$old_worktree/e2e/console-setup.test.sh" && bash "$old_worktree/e2e/console-setup.test.sh"
acceptance.expected: non-zero exit; the unchanged new test's case A reaches step 11 on the old script and reports 'FAIL: step 11 sign out all: status 409, want 303'. A syntax error, absent helper or incomplete stub is not acceptable evidence. Record this literal failure in the PR and remove the temporary worktree after collecting it.

Acceptance evidence 3: prepare this temporary copy of the fixed script and unchanged test, preserving e2e/ and full/config/api/checks.json and any compose-file argument needed by the script. Change only the action comparison in form_token_args from exact to prefix (one line, appropriate to the implementation). The test exits non-zero and reports the script's literal 'status 409' failures in both B: two-factor/around and C: legacy/around; the unmodified fixed script passes those same cases. First-match, prefix-match and greedy-last selection must each take a decoy in around. Quote the one-line mutant diff and both failing lines in the PR. Remove the temporary copy afterward and commit none of it.

Output preserves all steps 1-13, including 'ok: 11 POST /account/sessions/sign-out-all 303', 'ok: 11 jars B and C GET / 303 Location /sign-in?next=%2F' and 'ok: 11 jar A GET / 200 Signed in as'. Only ok: lines are quoted as evidence; no secret or page body is printed. If Docker or the local stack is unavailable, record the specific limitation in the PR as allowed by Completion evidence; do not substitute a console-main run for this proof.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; review confirms all four Security impact checklist items: no secret output and private temporary logs removed on exit; fixed-string exact action selection without evaluating HTML and one array element per encoded token; no new dependency, action, image or permission, with existing checkout SHA and persist-credentials: false preserved; fake returns closed-setup 404 before token validation and 409 for wrong-path or spent tokens. The sole new workflow step follows published_port helper and runs bash e2e/console-setup.test.sh; docs describe the exact-form rule, step-11 confirmation GET, unchanged replay/skip behavior and new test command.
